hero.title: Welcome to the tech world.
hero.lede: One roof, many engines. At Costa Digital you learn, build software, 3D print, meet the community, follow Caribbean tech stories, and drink great coffee.

services.title: Everything you can find here
services.subtitle: Training, software, Lab Maker, library, cowork, coffee, the patio, swag and Caribbean tech news.

membresia.title: Costa Digital Membership
membresia.description: You ask for the key and come when you want. Coffee, Thursday Cowork, masterclass, Lab Maker, library. The first 60 are Believers: numbered pin, name on the wall and Cursor credit to get into AI.

miembro.name: Member
miembro.note: Unlimited coffee · priority events · 10% off Tech Centre

residente.name: Resident · 20 spots
residente.note: Cowork with desk · 6 h meeting room · locker

formacion.title: Tech training · Tech Centre
formacion.description: You show up ready to get into tech and leave with something built. Eight weeks, max 12 people, Product or Data, and a demo day where you show your work. You learn next to people already shipping in the Caribbean.

software.title: Software & AI agents
software.description: You bring the mess: manual processes, nothing connected. We sit down, see what is worth automating, then build the platform or the agent. In phases, so you don't spend on what shouldn't be built.

diagnostico.name: Diagnosis · 45 min
diagnostico.note: What can and can't be automated

asesorias.title: Advisory & sessions
asesorias.description: You come with a question Google can't hold. Two hours to land what AI can do for you, and what it can't. If you're already building, an hour of mentoring: code, decisions, the next step.

biblioteca.title: Library
biblioteca.description: You sit down, open a book, and the noise falls away. Arduino, Terraform, electronics, leadership, fiction. Read here. If you belong to the house, take it home.

consulta.name: Read on site
consulta.note: Open when the house is open

cowork.title: Cowork space
cowork.description: You open the laptop and you're in. Wifi, desks and coffee next door. Thursdays the crew fills the house. A day to try it, or your chair if you're already a Resident.

jueves.name: Thursday Cowork
jueves.note: The weekly session, when the house is open

silla.name: Resident desk
silla.note: A reserved seat with the Resident plan

labMaker.title: Lab Maker
labMaker.description: You arrive with a file or an idea in your head. You leave with a piece in your hand. 3D printing, machine hours, or a three-hour workshop so you can make the next one yourself.

espacios.title: Spaces & events
espacios.description: You want to throw a night, a workshop, a board meeting. The patio holds 60 on a weeknight and more than 100 on Friday. Tech Nights started here. You bring the people; the house brings the roof.

laMarea.title: Caribbean tech news
laMarea.description: You have a Caribbean tech story that deserves to be seen. Coverage, a feature, or the profile of someone who trained here and now works. Sponsored pieces are labeled. The rest is reporting from the house.

cafe404.title: 404 Café
cafe404.tagline: A cafeteria that sustains the house.
cafe404.description: A place to connect, read about tech and cowork. A tech house: somewhere good to drink something nice and feel at home.

swag.title: Ally swag
swag.description: You leave the event wearing the house. Caps, pins, stickers from the people who keep the crew going. Your brand can sit on that table, next to the people who already show up.

mesa.name: Merch in the house
mesa.note: Caps, pins and stickers at events

kit.name: Ally kit
kit.note: Your brand on the table, made to fit

patrocinios.title: Sponsorships & partnerships
patrocinios.description: Your brand doesn't want a one-day banner. It wants a name on a space, training scholarships, to stay where people learn. ESAL donation with Art. 257 E.T. benefit.

services.footnote: Spaces and memberships require prepayment. Software is scoped in phases. WhatsApp quote within 24 h.

membership.title: The club where Caribbean tech moves.
membership.subtitle: The Caribbean tech house: a place to work, unlimited coffee, every event, the monthly masterclass, the library, the lab maker, and swag you earn. Every peso that comes in funds the mission and scholarships.
membership.launchNote: Your launch rate stays with you: while your membership is active, the price does not go up. Launch runs through 31 October 2026 or until the first 60 members. Annual plan: pay 10 months, get 12.
membership.creyentesLead: The first 60 members in the history of the house (any plan) are the Believers: the people who showed up when this was a hot patio and a promise. That gets thanked forever:

creyentesGifts.title: Numbered. One production run.
creyentesGifts.why: Enameled Believer pin with your number (#001–#060). Delivered with your first payment. Never reissued, never sold.

creyentesGifts.title: Your name in the house
creyentesGifts.why: The first believers stay on the house wall, permanently. Your name goes up at month three and is never removed.

creyentesGifts.title: US$20 in Cursor credits
creyentesGifts.why: Through our collaboration with SpaceX, every Believer gets US$20 in Cursor credits. And your launch rate stays while you stay active.

membership.onlyTitle: Benefits that grow with the house

onlyItems.title: The monthly masterclass + the library
onlyItems.text: Each month, a live virtual masterclass with industry experts (recorded for the library). Plus physical book loans from the Costa Digital library and selected recordings made in the house.

onlyItems.title: Earned by belonging
onlyItems.text: A welcome kit and special-edition surprises every quarter: stickers, pins, shirts and caps that only circulate among members.

membership.foodLead: Membership includes coffee; food is separate. Prepaid vouchers make the daily menu cheaper: you order, they stamp the voucher, done.

foodItems.title: Daily menu
foodItems.text: Lunch at the house whenever you want.

howRows.text: Rooms switch between classrooms and cowork. The availability calendar is published every week. The patio and café stay open to the community all day.
Unlimited bar coffee (espresso, black, cappuccino) for you in the house. The rest of the menu is paid as usual. 404 Café profits keep the house open and fund scholarships.
Community events are yours: guaranteed seat and priority entry. Private patio rentals are not included (you book them with your 10%).
In your first two weeks we introduce you to the community and expect you at your first event. Nobody is left loose: belonging starts on day one.

tyc: Monthly or annual prepay with automatic card billing. Membership activates on payment and renews in advance. You can cancel auto-debit anytime in your profile; the paid period is not refunded and access continues until the cutoff date. Annual: 12 months for the price of 10. Your launch rate holds while active; after canceling, re-entry is at the current price.
Personal and non-transferable. One holder per membership.
Limited spots. Resident: 20. When full, a waitlist opens with priority for the annual plan.
Pause and change of tier. You can pause up to 2 months per year (notice before cutoff) and move up or down anytime.
No refunds. Pauses keep your balance and your spot.
Unlimited coffee (all plans): espresso, black or cappuccino at the bar, personal consumption on visit days. Reasonable use; not transferable and not for guests.
Lab Maker: members with prior induction and a reserved slot; materials are extra or you bring your own.
Believers program: first 60 launch members. Numbered pin with first payment; name on the wall at month three. Status survives pauses, not cancellation.
Membership discounts apply from the second active month and do not stack with other promotions.
Hours and calendar. Resident cowork follows the weekly calendar. The house may reserve rooms for training and events with at least 7 days notice.
Meeting room: unused hours do not roll over; book ahead, subject to availability.
Paid events: member special price and resident free entry (from month three) apply to house-organized events, one seat per member, prior registration.
Locker and mail: locker subject to availability; the house receives packages during hours and does not hold valuables or perishables.
Meal vouchers: prepaid, personal, 404 Café daily menu. 60 days (10) or 90 days (20); unused meals are not refunded.
Physical library: one book at a time, up to 15 days, logged at reception. Failure to return suspends the benefit and you pay replacement.
Community. The house is a safe, diverse, respectful space. Breaking the code can end a membership.
Data. Registration means accepting Fundación Código Abierto (ESAL) data policy, the entity that invoices your membership.
